sanskrit_verse:
सोमः शौचं ददावासां गन्धर्वश्च शुभां गिरम् ।
पावकः सर्वमेध्यत्वं मेध्या वै योषितो ह्यतः ॥
transliteration: somaḥ śaucaṃ dadāv āsāṃ gandharvaś ca śubhāṃ giram | pāvakaḥ sarvamedhyatvaṃ medhyā vai yoṣito hy ataḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Soma bestowed purity upon women; Gandharva granted auspicious speech; Pavaka ensured universal sanctity—thus, women are inherently pure, sacred vessels of consciousness.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from divine bestowal, not social construct
Causation arises through conscious consecration by celestial entities
Capacity-based responsibility is intrinsic to the divinely ordained nature
Restoration logic aligns with original consecrated state
Consciousness alignment occurs through recognition of inherent sanctity
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, any case involving violation or diminishment of a woman's status must invoke the foundational consecration by Soma, Gandharva, and Pavaka. The threshold of responsibility lies in misalignment from the divinely established purity, requiring immediate restoration rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causality through celestial acts of sanctification. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential degradation when consciousness forgets its consecrated origin. Responsibility is proportional to awareness of the original bestowal. Non-punitive reality rule demands that corrective action restores alignment without inflicting suffering.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Realign offending party with the original consecration truth
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Acknowledge deviation from sacred foundation
Capacity Restoration: Reinforce understanding of woman’s inherent sanctity
Integrity Reintegration: Facilitate reconnection with the consciousness of purity
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law flows from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Purity is restored. Consciousness prevails. There is no punishment—only realignment.
